blocks.text: Big news for all the Gleeks out there! ‘Glee,’ the beloved musical comedy-drama series, is coming back more than a decade after its original run ended. Through the show’s official social media accounts, Disney+ and Hulu announced that the series is returning with the caption, “Currently gleeking out!” Ryan Murphy, one of the show’s creators, said he had noticed a renewed interest in the series, particularly among younger viewers, prompting him to consider revisiting the show. “So many young people now watch it.
